description: This Java source file defines the main activity for an Android application that fetches and displays recent StackOverflow questions tagged 'android'. It handles network connectivity monitoring, preference management, XML parsing, and UI updating via WebView, implementing asynchronous downloading of XML data.

classes.name: NetworkActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that manages network communication, XML parsing, and UI updates

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and registers connectivity receiver

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Checks network preferences and attempts to load data if allowed

methods.name: updateConnectedFlags
methods.description: Checks current network connection status and updates flags accordingly

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Triggers the asynchronous download of the XML feed based on network status and preferences

methods.name: showErrorPage
methods.description: Displays an error message in the WebView when network conditions prevent data loading

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for settings and refresh

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including opening settings and refreshing content

inner_classes.name: DownloadXmlTask
inner_classes.description: AsyncTask subclass to download and process XML feed without blocking UI

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs network request and data retrieval in background

methods.name: onPostExecute
methods.description: Updates UI with downloaded content after background processing

inner_classes.name: NetworkReceiver
inner_classes.description: BroadcastReceiver that monitors network connectivity changes and updates UI state

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles connectivity change events and updates flags and UI toast messages

methods.name: loadXmlFromNetwork
methods.description: Downloads XML data from the provided URL, parses it, and builds an HTML string for display

methods.name: downloadUrl
methods.description: Creates an HTTP connection to download data from the specified URL
